independent_controls.HC1_index_in_late_window: An independent OS process creates an index after scratch validation and before public BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Prospective requirement: REFUSED (PUBLICATION_READSET_CHANGED or PUBLICATION_SCHEMA_CHANGED), no_mutation false, external index preserved, no candidate rows, seeded rows preserved. Clean and seeded strata.
independent_controls.HC2_schema_object_families: Independent process creates a TRIGGER, a VIEW, a TABLE, and changes user_version metadata at the same late window. Prospective requirement for each: REFUSED with truthful no_mutation false, object preserved, rows unchanged. The documented schema contract covers tables/indexes/triggers/views and version metadata.
independent_controls.HC3_late_refusal_with_trigger: Independent process creates a TRIGGER, then a domain refusal is raised at the same boundary. Prospective requirement: REFUSED, no_mutation false (schema changed), table rows unchanged, trigger preserved.
independent_controls.HC4_concurrent_fact_and_index: Independent process admits a new B2 objective fact AND creates an index during the late window. Prospective requirement: REFUSED, no_mutation false, the independent fact rows survive as a superset (no deletion/rollback of foreign state), no b3_source/b3_transition candidate rows.
independent_controls.HC5_sigkill_cold_schema_rows: Real SIGKILL at scratch boundary and at public publication boundary, clean and seeded. Prospective requirement: cold inspection in a distinct process shows schema and rows unchanged and integrity ok; kill after successful return leaves committed rows replayable.
independent_controls.HC6_refusal_then_retry_no_ghosts: A refused proposal (bad origin) followed by a correct retry. Prospective requirement: refusal leaves no rows; retry is ELIGIBLE_NONCAUSAL with exactly its own rows and no target/source ghosts from the refused attempt.
independent_controls.HC7_no_mutation_semantics: Measure no_mutation across: fresh success, exact replay, valid-empty target without permission, denied target, refusal without external change, refusal with external row, refusal with external schema. Prospective requirement: no_mutation is true only when the request itself produced no durable public change and no external change occurred; any external schema/row change forces false; refusal without external change yields true.
independent_controls.HC8_no_ddl_inside_immediate: During the public BEGIN IMMEDIATE window an independent process attempts DDL with timeout 0. Prospective requirement: the DDL cannot commit (writer lock), publication still commits, final schema equals the pre-run schema plus expected tables only. This documents a lock boundary, not cryptographic protection.

interpretation_rule: Keep failed assertions RED and literal. External raw SQL is a privileged schema-writer adversary distinct from an unauthenticated B2 request; results show missing promised schema/readset coverage, not that arbitrary DBA corruption is preventable. SIGKILL is process-death evidence only, never power-loss/fsync proof. No test result authorizes CAN008/CAN011 law, M2 integration, production adoption or psychological claims. These controls are independently authored by this reviewer and are additional to, not a replacement of, the two frozen B3A-I2 REDs.
